Hi Maria — thanks for the quick upload and the bank letter. A few small items so we can get the PO moving to conditioned release:

- The W-8BEN-E looks mostly complete but section III (Claim of Tax Treaty Benefits) needs the article number filled and the capacity in which the company claims benefits (e.g., "payments for independent personal services / royalties").
- We require a beneficial owner declaration that explicitly names any individuals with >25% ownership. I’m attaching our preferred template (beneficial_owner_declaration_template.docx) — if your legal can sign and notarize that (local notary is fine if it includes attestation and contact info), that satisfies our onboarding for non-US entities.
- For treaty/withholding treatment, please confirm the exact article you’re claiming and provide any supporting tax residency docs. If you claim Brazil-US treaty under Article X (for royalties) please indicate whether the payments are considered royalties or service fees — we need that to set withholding code on the PO.

Timeline: if we receive the completed declaration + updated W-8BEN-E by end of day tomorrow (Fri 12/11), Procurement can move the vendor to "conditional PO" status while Finance completes the tax validation. Conditional PO allows invoicing up to $25k; full PO issuance follows tax validation.

Doc links and next steps:
- Procurement ticket: https://app.redwood.com/procurement/tickets/PR-4821
- Beneficial owner template: https://www.docusign.com/templates/beneficial-owner (or use attached)

If your legal has questions about wording, loop in Ben — he’s copied and is handling our vendor tax evidence review.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Vendor Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
attachments: beneficial_owner_declaration_template.docx
